name: manga-tracker
description: Track what you read, find what to buy next: a manga shelf + US price checker

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,site -c red,blue "npm run dev-server" "npm run dev-client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.typecheck: cd server && npm run typecheck && cd ../client && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: cd server && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build
